name: Brazier of Commanding Fire Elementals

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Summon a Fire Elemental
powers.text: Magic action (once per dawn): A Fire Elemental appears in the space nearest the brazier. It obeys you and takes its turn right after yours, and it's gone after 1 hour, at 0 Hit Points, or when you dismiss it.

powers.name: Dismiss the elemental
powers.text: Bonus Action: send back the Fire Elemental you called with the brazier.

summary: Once a day, call a Fire Elemental that obeys you for up to 1 hour.
text: Take a Magic action with the brazier to call a Fire Elemental into the unoccupied space nearest it. The elemental understands your languages, does as you command, and takes its turn immediately after yours. It's gone after 1 hour, when it drops to 0 Hit Points, or when you dismiss it as a Bonus Action. The brazier can't call another until the next dawn.
